## Body

PR #247 merged as 88636516859d2249548920c9e7aaadc53b5178a5. SETTLE retargets the existing per-pending-turn deadline: no additional polling/task. Grace adds a pane-keyed entry only after a held close lands, pruned on the next grant; expired entries are inert. Its process-start probe normally stays in-process but can use the existing counted absolute /bin/ps fallback. Do not promise unconditional zero launches. OMP removes one idle HTTP post per iteration; Copilot also suppresses the following working post through existing state deduplication.

Deployed receipt: https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/pull/247#issuecomment-6996270793 ; output note 1536f871. PID61945, 2026-11-19 00:54:05–00:54:26Z, exact launches 428→428, machine168.1/s. Prior PID23167: 591→592 over20s, machine186.2/s. CPU/RSS snapshots are not comparable steady-state evidence: daemon ages48s versus36m28s. No causal speedup claimed. Merge delivery released the role before the requested after-deploy output, so that valid note records writer_holds_role false.

magicWand: one paired-measurement helper emitting same-PID cumulative CPU-time, RSS, spawn-site deltas and deployed commit would avoid lifetime-%cpu comparison traps.
